title: the key lists and tips name the keys as they are now
why: GEARRULES said Keys 1 to 4 bring up your guns (v21.93) and taught a belt of 1-4 guns, 5-6 throw, 7-8 heal, 9 plate with G, H, U and J (v26.02), and keep a plate on a key. The Settings Keys window still listed H heal (tap), armour plate (hold), but H does nothing since the item wheel took the heals. The locked keys read 1 - 9 and the rebind note said 1-9 cannot be rebound, but the gun keys are 1 to 8 and 0 (nine kinds, the rocket launcher on 0, key 9 does nothing). The item hover card named HEAL, THROW and PLATE keys that do nothing. All now say what is true, short and lower case: the guns on 1 to 8 and 0, the heals, grenades and plate on the item wheel (hold q).
now: The Keys window no longer lists an H heal row, it says the locked gun keys are 1 - 8, 0, and the controls tips point at the item wheel (hold q) instead of the old belt keys.
